what: Competitor blog calculates Patreon's total effective fee at ~13% (10% platform + 2.9% + $0.30 processing), showing that at $10,000/month revenue the annual fee burden reaches $15,600.
verbatim_snippet: "Patreon now charges a flat 10% platform fee (people joining after August 4, 2025) plus 2.9% + $0.30 payment processing on every transaction. That's 13% total. The math: At $5,000/month revenue, you're paying $650 monthly in fees, $7,800 annually. Scale to $10,000/month and you're losing $15,600 per year."
date: Accessed April 2026; references August 2025 pricing change
notes: Third-party comparative (sub-type b). Author: BuddyBoss editorial. Other platforms: BuddyBoss, Ghost, Mighty Networks, Ko-fi (mentioned elsewhere in article). Dimension: total fee calculation and cost at scale. Disclosed affiliation: BuddyBoss is a competitor to Patreon. Text from search engine snippet. "Losing" framing reflects competitive bias.
